name: dumbbell standing front raise twist
description: A front raise combined with a torso twist, working the shoulders and the obliques together.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, holding a dumbbell in both hands at thigh level.
Raise the dumbbell in front of you to chest height.
Rotate your torso to one side, turning from the ribs while your hips face forward.
Rotate back to the center and lower the dumbbell with control.
Alternate sides each rep and keep the weight light.
